fields.statement: QA cycle 1, by hand with the built binary (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) in a scratch repo with a bare origin, a change set branch cs/qa-cs and a fake gh whose PR check 'test (4/5)' (Actions run 42) stays FAILURE. rhiza ship check --reruns 2 called four times on one head: calls 1 and 2 printed 'not settled: reran the failed jobs of run 42' and exited 1, with the ship record's rerun_count at 1 then 2 (written before gh run rerun); calls 3 and 4 failed with no further rerun; gh.log held exactly two 'run rerun 42 --failed'. A new head with no flag was rerun exactly once (rerun_count reset to 1), then failed. Flipping the check to SUCCESS passed ('1 check passed', exit 0). --reruns 0, --reruns -1 and api call ship.check with {"reruns":0} each gave the usage error '--reruns takes a whole number of at least 1' (exit 2); --reruns abc gave 'flag --reruns takes an integer' (exit 2). Scoped tests passed: go test ./internal/api -run Ship, ./internal/workflow/..., and TestScripts (plan-workflow|run-ship-rerun|ship-check-ci-test-findings|describe-golden).

QA cycle 1, by hand with the built binary and a fake gh: a head whose diff from origin/main touches only .rhiza/x/note, red after its two reruns, failed with 'PR #78 at 378f1f9: failed: test (4/5) after 2 reruns; the PR changes only .rhiza/'. A head that also touches app.go, red after one rerun with a failed-run log naming an RSpec test, failed with 'PR #78 at c06657e: failed: test (4/5) after 1 reruns; failing tests: rspec ./spec/system/garden_location_spec.rb:11' and no .rhiza/ note. A red check with no Actions run (no rerun spent) printed today's 'PR #78 at 0fb5524: failed: test (4/5)'. No detail said unrelated, flaky or on main.

QA cycle 1: read internal/workflow/builtin/plan.toml (and plan-milestone.toml): wait-pr and wait-rebased until 'rhiza ship check --reruns 2 --settled', pr-green and rebased-green run 'rhiza ship check --reruns 2', routes and max_visits unchanged; ship-change untouched. Drove those exact commands by hand with the built binary against a fake gh: a red head was rerun twice and then failed with the reruns spent and the .rhiza-only note, which is the detail the failing step carries. Ran go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/plan-workflow' (ci-flake, ci-flake-red, pr) and ./internal/workflow/....
